method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a date module (built-in date functions only), a seat-neutral core (soca-core.l4) and one seat layer (the claimant) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; one regulative rule (s 4(b)) run by EVALTRACE; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Survival of Causes of Action Act 1940 (SA), register version 8.2.2006, fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 (unauthorised RTF; not the Open Australian Legal Corpus), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/survival-of-causes-of-action-act-1940.txt (text sha256 aa2509320524cb71608dfa212805228d2c02718ed0e08e6dba6a221c328d3faf per its meta.json). The Act has no regulations; its numbers (two six-month periods) and the Schedule of prescribed dust diseases are its own.

seat: the claimant whose claim meets a death: the executor or administrator (or beneficiary) of a person who died with a claim, the person with a dust-related condition asking what their estate would keep, and the injured person whose claim lies against someone who has died (soca-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run soca-dates.l4 ; l4 run soca-core.l4 ; l4 run soca-seat.l4 ; l4 run soca-cases.l4
checks.result: 115 assertions written, 115 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (s 4(b) six months after the grant changed to seven) failed exactly the 10 predicted assertions and was reverted
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: the whole operative Act: ss 2, 3 (with the Schedule), 4, 5, 6. Out: s 1 (short title), s 7 (spent repeals), the 2001 amending Act's transitional provision (actions pending in 2001 only), quantum of damages (general law). Reasons in NOTES.md.
